Beans Central.

Brand identity

One ingredient. A world of possibility.

Explore the story

The idea

Familiar food.
A fresh appetite.

Beans don’t have to be the side story.

A bean, a fork and a plate: the identity begins with a simple invitation to eat. Warm colours and rounded type make it approachable; six distinctive dishes give it somewhere to go.

“There’s more to beans” connects the food, the campaign language and the everyday objects that carry the identity.

Design
Eyilade Oridamisi
Scope
Identity, art direction, campaigns, menu, packaging & digital

An expanded portfolio study of the original Beans Central identity. Campaigns and applications are design concepts, with AI-assisted photography and mockups.

Identity

A small mark.
A lot of personality.

The existing mark stays intact. Its warm colours and rounded forms set the tone for everything around it.

Bean. Fork. Plate.
One familiar invitation.

Red#E0012E

Graphic language

Made from the
same ingredients.

A supporting bean illustration and concentric plate lines create rhythm across the system. They give the food room to lead, while keeping each application recognisably related.

The campaign

Six dishes.
Six good reasons.

Each dish gets its own headline, colour balance and composition. A shared type system and signature strip bring the collection together without making every message look the same.

The menu

Plenty to choose from.
Easy to take in.

A clear six-dish menu translates the campaign into something useful: readable names, short descriptions and a consistent place for each plate.

Good food.
Many ways.

On the go

The brand,
out in the world.

Warm paper, a confident ochre sleeve, a red carton and a simple seal. The applications use the same visual language at different scales—from the carry bag to the smallest detail.

Digital expressions

A little appetite
for the everyday.

A focused dish story and a broader menu story adapt the same idea to a vertical format. The food stays prominent, and the message stays short.
